visualReview.notes: Inspected all48 current portable/shared/medium-fi/native frames in nine labeled contact sheets, plus full-resolution native whole connected house, central pediment/entrance, end cellar door and rear roof views. The raised gabled center, low links, wider end pavilions, four arched dormers, green roofs, two pale chimneys, repeated window bands, cellar pediment hoods and supported entrances read coherently. The continuous author/inspect/fix pass closed dormer backs and roof joints, seated the center chimney in its roof and added doorway aprons; the hidden foundation extends to the placement datum.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Six roles reuse five existing256px graphs: stucco, wood_plain, stone_limestone, metal_standing_seam and storefront. Metric UVs, linear tints, five nearby draws/one skyline, separate POSITION/NORMAL streams and matching CPU/GPU geometry accounting. No embedded image, private atlas or new graph. Each used graph reads once; unload releases every model geometry.

mediumFiReview.notes: Four authored LODs773/1967/3187/3355 triangles. Initial skyline+district234176bytes; closeup276136bytes. Skyline keeps all five connected roof masses, center pediment, four closed dormer housings, two stacks, physical recessed entrances and supported aprons/treads; it omits window/glazed fan modules and close quoin/pipe/medallion proxies. District adds the arched attic/dormer glazing and complete window rhythm; street/closeup add small bands, pipes and original plain medallion proxies. Synthetic contexts check style/LOD/tier coherence; native views establish approximate geographic fit.
